dogecoin.text:
@d34dr4661t @xx1tjx @9mm_smg Dogecoin has unlimited supply; buy something else.  They add ~10,000 new coins every hour to the supply.  
If you had something valuable, like a Michael Jordan rookie card, but every day another 100 of them are added to the supply, they’d all inevitably lose value.  No LT upside.

@d34dr4661t Don’t shoot the messenger; you’re wrong.   I’m indifferent whether you act on the good information or not.  Every new block (approx. every minute of every day) releases exactly 10,000 new dogecoin. That’s >5 Billion added to the circulating supply last year.  There is no cap.
